Supreme Court of the United States
No. 25A515
JOSE DURAN, INDIVIDUALLY AND AS REPRESENTATIVE OF A CLASS
OF JUDGMENT CREDITORS OF THE ESTATE OF
FERDINAND E. MARCOS,
 Applicant
v.
UNITED STATES, ET AL.
O R D E R
UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the
applicant,
IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of
Appeals for the Second Circuit, case Nos. 24-185 and 25-186, is hereby
recalled and stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before
Wednesday, November 12, 2025, by 4 p.m. (EST).
 /s/ Sonia Sotomayor
 Associate Justice of the Supreme
 Court of the United States
Dated this 5th
day of November, 2025.
